# Pauli Contextuality Lab

> Unified Lean 4.35.0 (Mathlib v4.35.0) and exact-arithmetic research repository covering spectral bounds on Pauli contextuality, floor-saturating states (including |Psi_{3m}>), exact four-qubit C3 optima (368 vs 344), Jonah's Conjecture E (all 9 cases, N >= 4), exact disjoint Mermin tensor degrees ((7^k - 5^k)/2 and (6^k - 4^k)/2), and sequential contextuality evidence bounds.

## Start here

- [README.md](README.md): Overview, verbatim #print axioms proofs, quickstart, and track summary
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Canonical instructions, commands, hard rules, and known traps for coding agents
- [CLAIMS.md](CLAIMS.md): Tagged claims ledger with explicit falsification criteria
- [LIMITATIONS.md](LIMITATIONS.md): Honest scope, verification boundaries, AI-contribution & CRediT disclosure
- [ERRATA.md](ERRATA.md): Corrections log, version-vs-concept DOI convention, and formal withdrawal plan
- [REPLICATION.md](REPLICATION.md): Clean-clone replication protocol and run log
- [docs/statement-fidelity.md](docs/statement-fidelity.md): Line-by-line mapping between Lean 4 declarations and mathematical definitions
- [docs/mega-atlas-cross-reference.md](docs/mega-atlas-cross-reference.md): Exhaustive cross-reference against the 1,900-problem Unsolved Problems Mega-Atlas V2

## Formal proofs & papers

- [lean/README.md](lean/README.md): Unified Lean 4.35.0 trust base (HoggarBound, ContextualityTensor, Evidence)
- [formalization.yaml](formalization.yaml): Palomar-compatible provenance metadata
- [blueprint/src/content.tex](blueprint/src/content.tex): Declaration-checked Lean Blueprint
- [papers/README.md](papers/README.md): Guide to the three research preprints and Muller/Saniga/Holweck/Giorgetti/Kelleher correspondence

## Tracks & architecture

- [tracks/spectral-bounds/README.md](tracks/spectral-bounds/README.md): Track 1 — Spectral floor, saturating states, N=4..5 ladders, Conjecture E
- [tracks/disjoint-mermin/README.md](tracks/disjoint-mermin/README.md): Track 2 — Disjoint Mermin squares & pentagrams (Muller & Saniga Sec. 6)
- [tracks/sequential-evidence/README.md](tracks/sequential-evidence/README.md): Track 3 — Exact sequential certificates & setting-bias attack
